methodology: selected_track identifies the recommended first bench purchase; implemented_track identifies this repository's existing firmware. Buy one Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.64 SKU 31197 V2 and use its official V2 examples after checking the received revision. Measure and test USB/display before final enclosure work. Prices retain their individual recorded dates and are not Finland landed quotes. Taby V1 support is separate; alternatives are not mechanically or firmware interchangeable.
